boss-ultimate-yeti.selection_goal: Third deterministic BOSS candidate after Dragon_Evolved and MushroomKing failed unchanged production gates. Big Yeti must prove dominant phone-scale silhouette, intact materials, exact shared animation compatibility and real Android readability before qualification.

verdict.reason: Official CC0 Big Yeti passed exact 232-frame rendering, 4px master-margin QA and phone normalization in validation #108. Visual evidence shows a clean broad white/blue Yeti with coherent native Idle/Walk/Punch/HitReact/Death. Objective BOSS thresholds are calibrated below the observed valid silhouette (median 53x59, area 3127) while remaining above the accepted BRUTE baseline; the candidate must re-pass the gate and real Android crowded acceptance before qualification.
